Question: Which 5 product categories have the heaviest products on average? Use English names.
text:
```sql
SELECT pct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       AVG(p.product_weight_g) AS avg_weight_g
FROM products p
JOIN product_category_name_translation pct
  ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY avg_weight_g DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
This query averages the weight of products for each category, joins to get the English category name, and returns the five categories with the highest average product weight.
